user.title: CPAP Local Setup
user.description: Choose how to connect to your CPAP device's SD card.

fetch_method.http: WiFi SD Card (EZShare or similar) — direct HTTP from the adapter
fetch_method.local: Locally mounted SD card or network share path
fetch_method.esp: ESP WiFi Bridge — an ESP32 that switches networks to pull data from the adapter

http.title: HTTP Connection (WiFi SD Card)
http.description: Connect via a WiFi SD card adapter such as EZ Share. Ensure your CPAP is off and the adapter is powered and accessible.

local.title: Local Mounted Path
local.description: Connect to a locally mounted SD card or network share that exposes the CPAP SD card files.

esp.title: ESP WiFi Bridge
esp.description: Configure an ESPHome device to bridge Home Assistant to the WiFi SD card adapter. The ESP will switch networks once a day to download data, then reconnect and POST it here.

data_description.esp_device_id: The ESPHome device configured with the WiFi bridge firmware.
data_description.cpap_id: A short logical name for this CPAP (e.g. bedroom_cpap). Must match the cpap_id configured in the ESP YAML. Used to route incoming data to the right integration entry.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the CPAP device. Check the URL or path and try again.
error.invalid_path: The specified path does not exist or is not readable.

sync_now.name: Sync Now
sync_now.description: Immediately fetch the latest CPAP data, bypassing the scheduled sync time.

fetch_esp.name: Fetch via ESP WiFi Bridge
fetch_esp.description: Trigger an ESP to fetch CPAP data from the WiFi SD card adapter.

fetch_http.name: Fetch via HTTP
fetch_http.description: Fetch CPAP data directly from a WiFi SD card adapter over HTTP.
